design.physical: Original finite S23 fleet, stock, permission, inspection and owner review rules. No traffic, resource topup, fabricated need or packet-loss change.
design.clocks: Native source time remains owned by the copied actual controller. Extra wall pauses expose finite native queues and moving vehicles; they are never added as human work. Actual provider wall remains charged by the existing model availability rule.
design.manual: Actual native authenticated read→decide→relay receipts; legacy policy:conventional is not used as a human workflow.
design.model: B6 uses the configured real OpenRouter model with the declared cap; Gemma is labeled Gemma. No simulated model response or Gemini quality claim.
design.presentation: Two independent observer ports can show the same seeded microcase. Observer truth and actor received perspectives remain distinct. Camera/follow/feed reads are real. World-control POSTs are rejected while a runner owns its clock.
limits: Microdemonstration, not a primary comparative score or new gain estimate. Viewer/host overhead may affect provider wall time.
Native human durations are explicit hypothetical assumptions; source owner review is scripted, not a human trial.
The default simulator A/B algorithm selector is not a C_manual-versus-B6 controller comparison.
A recorded replay must be labeled recorded. This adapter prepares a live standalone episode and never opens/pauses a running study.

instrumentation: Rebased import URLs retain canonical fingerprint roots.
Explicit fixed observer ports make same-origin observer login valid.
Callbacks persist ignored private access handles, add wall-only presentation pacing and hold servers open after actual completion.
The live observer adapter rejects world-control mutations; camera, scoped snapshots, feeds and measurements remain read-only native views.
